title: Current Virtual USB authority and scope
summary: The current executable baseline is oorexx_virtual_usb_v0.1-dev9.zip. It provides a provider-neutral USB device model, generic HID descriptor support, CTAPHID framing, a CTAP2 FIDO_2_0 development authenticator, and a Linux Raw Gadget provider. The semantic package is qualified; clean presenter-owned live HID/hidraw enumeration remains pending.
invariants: oorexx_virtual_usb_v0.1-dev9.zip is the current continuation baseline.
The application models a semantic USB device; native USB presentation belongs to providers.
Generic HID support is Virtual USB core functionality rather than FIDO-specific special casing.
Linux Raw Gadget is one provider; the in-memory provider remains the deterministic semantic-test route.
No live browser/WebAuthn or FIDO certification claim exists until separately qualified.
procedure: Continue from dev9 source and its exact package/dependency evidence rather than reconstructing from earlier dev1/dev3 copies.
Treat live target results as additional qualification evidence, not as permission to silently change semantic behavior.

provenance.claim: README identifies the dev9 baseline, package capabilities, development boundaries and pending live-host acceptance.
